hygieneControlRows.claim: fires on git commit or git push operations
hygieneControlRows.actual: The guard cannot distinguish a command that commits from a command that mentions committing. Behaviour depends on incidental string content in an argument rather than on the operation being performed.
hygieneControlRows.positiveControl: git log --grep=commit is treated as a commit. git branch -D leftover is permitted. git branch -D leftover-commit is refused. Same operation, different branch name, opposite verdict.
hygieneControlRows.whyOwnRow: A control matching a word in a command string rather than the operation performed. Fires reliably. An audit that only asks whether the guard exists would never flag it. Cost measured in hours.
